governing_caveat: The index for a part number is identical in every market it appears in: our list price is global and the observed competitor price is a single national listing. Every market-level average in this file is therefore a composition effect, not a market difference.
This file cannot support a claim that Israel differs from the UK, or that CV differs from LCV.
85% of rows carry the identical median index, so market averages are dominated by which parts each market checks.
caveats: Cost is estimated as 50% of list, the book average. It is not a purchase cost.
The observed prices are what a price-comparison site showed, not a transaction, and 83% of rows rest on a single listing.
